description: The homepage pitch on a clean machine: a plain docker-compose.yml (a Node API on 3000 and Postgres with a password in its environment), then flisk import --yes and flisk up. The API must answer through Traefik on its own port, reach Postgres as db:5432, and the time from flisk import to the first answer is recorded.
checkName: 📦 Compose import to a running stack on a clean machine
